title: Rayen Castle
geometryBasis: 147 outer building points record the entire present fortress perimeter, including 12 named-in-controls rounded perimeter arcs. The eastern gate and interior volumes are estimated from the photographs and written context.
sectionBasis: The exact Qualla views resolve rounded exposed merlons, tapered parapet and cylindrical gateway. The unchanged 384-metre native field provides the ground contact.
limitations: The outer outline and tower arcs are mapped. Gateway station, wall thicknesses, sectional heights and position of interior groups are estimates.
The lower ruin courts and raised inner citadel are representative exterior geometry. Roof loss, room-level archaeological accuracy and unseen interior details are outside scope.
Modern terrain is preserved. Relative terrace heights and present foundation conditions remain approximate.
